direction: Original SolAir robot main host, four independent compact floating yellow/purple/pink/blue creatures; no borrowed GitHub characters

prompts.manuscript: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original compact floating website mascot isolated on genuinely transparent background. A premium playful glossy 3D collectible creature, very simple rounded silhouette, expressive face, polished soft clay/vinyl finish, beautiful studio lighting, charming like an original developer-site companion. NOT a humanoid, NOT the SolAir solar/wind robot, NOT an existing GitHub character, no franchise reference. This is an original independent personality, one of four thesis-team helpers. Mostly a compact head-and-body form with tiny limbs, no long legs, fits a square composition. Entire character and props inside frame with plenty of transparent margins. No floor, scenery, text, letters, watermark or UI. Subject: a small cheerful golden-YELLOW starling-like bird with a rounded pear-shaped body, tiny cream wings, amber beak, lively dark eyes and one swept crest feather. A simple miniature ivory open book held under one wing, a small cobalt bookmark. Gently floating at a three-quarter angle, attentive kind expression. Dominant warm yellow and cream, minimal blue accent. Distinct original bird shape, not a duck and not an owl; smooth sculpted feathers rather than realistic fur.
